rationale: Panel B's signal establishes reproducibility and single-removal minimality for the comparison deployment. A shared deployment-manifest template does not establish that this result transfers to the focal deployment, especially within the explicit limits on cross-deployment equivalence.

signal_basis.exact_text: Panel B ends at a three-change background-path subset that reproduces its latency failure; removing any retained change makes that failure disappear.
Panel B is assigned to a comparison checkout deployment maintained by another team.
Manifest-template identity is the only stated cross-deployment connection; code, component semantics and failure mechanisms are not stipulated equal.
